# Rust sealed-package v1 fixtures

`cloud-test.pem` is a **test-only RSA private key**, never a production key.
The two packages were generated by Rust, not by the Go fixture helpers.

Generation used a temporary standalone Cargo harness containing the unchanged
Matcha-claw `runtime-host/modules/sealed-resource/src/package/{common,agent,skill}.rs`,
`descriptor.rs` and domain types; unrelated API/store exports were omitted.
Its test called `SealedAgentPackage::seal_with_cloud_key` and
`SealedSkillPackage::seal_with_cloud_key` with this key's SPKI public PEM and
key ID `rust-fixture`, called `open` with each returned authorization key, then
wrote `package_bytes()`. Run that harness with `cargo test cross_language_fixture::generate -- --nocapture`.

Inputs cover `<>&`, literal U+2028/U+2029 and backslash-u text, optional `false`
descriptor flags, required `AGENTS.md`/`SKILL.md`, empty files and binary bytes.
OAEP/GCM randomness makes regenerated package bytes differ; manifest digests remain stable.
Go regressions verify the original serde manifest digest/AAD and the complete
upload-draft → publish → device authorization → download/decrypt service flow.
